description: This file defines the EmployeeDeletedEvent class within the OrangeHRM PIM event namespace. The class extends a generic Event class and encapsulates data related to employee deletion events, specifically storing employee numbers.

classes.name: EmployeeDeletedEvent
classes.description: A class representing an event triggered when employees are deleted, storing employee numbers involved in the event.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor method that initializes the event with an array of employee numbers.

methods.name: getEmpNumbers
methods.description: Returns the array of employee numbers associated with this event.
